featuredArticle.spotlight: If you're trying to figure out how a lead that's 60, 90, or 180 days old can out-earn a fresh one, this is the piece that walks through the actual economics. It covers the scripts, the follow-up cadence, and the math that makes aged leads the quiet workhorse of a sustainable pipeline — especially useful reading right before enrollment season makes fresh leads expensive and scarce.
